description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CACI International Inc. is hiring a Software Developer and IT Tech Professional to provide IT support for one customer and web server development for another. The role includes supporting users across Tiers 1–3, maintaining and converting a PHP web server to Python, and documenting software development and Navy IT processes.
Software Developer and IT Technician maintaining PHP web servers, migrating to Python, troubleshooting IT issues, documenting SOPs

Responsibilities:
• Work with customer to definite software development requirements
• Provide development support int he form of bug fixes, new features and code cleanup
• Work with IT group to take care of Tiers 1-3 IT issues submitted via phone line, functional mailbox, leadership and in person
• Work with both software and hardware in order to troubeshoot issues
• Create SOPs for user guides and Navy IT process and provide professional documentation practices to any software development completed
• Work with a web server currently coded in PHP by providing maintenance and minor feature implementation
• Convert current PHP web server solution to python

Requirements:
• Must have a degree in relevant field to software development
• Must be comfortable with developing in PHP and Python
• Must have or be able to obtain a secret or interim secret clearance
• Must have or be able to achieve CompTIA Sec+ Certification before start date
• Can balance multiple projects and tasks at the same time
• Excellent communication and written skills

Preferred:
• Previous professional Navy environment experience
• Advanced skillset in PHP and Python development
• Previous profession IT expertise
